verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships a native MDM module that lets admins confirm device management status, view per-device security posture, enforce settings, and apply a one-click secure baseline for macOS/Windows [oneleet-docs-9][oneleet-docs-10][oneleet-docs-22][oneleet-docs-23]. This covers per-employee workstation compliance tracking via an integrated agent, but the docs never specify granular checks like disk encryption, screen-lock timeout, or password-manager presence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of individual compliance checks (disk encryption, screen lock, password manager) and any independent/hands-on confirmation of per-employee reporting granularity.
